==Description==
'''Limitation Makes Creativity''', sometimes referred to as just '''Limitation''', is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that only appears in [[Challenge Trials]], after [[Fog]] and before [[Flying Enemies]]. When a [[Challenge Trials|Challenge Trial]] with this modifier is beaten, it will be unlocked for the player to apply on any match.

'''Limitation Makes Creativity''' is part of a group of six modifiers consisting of itself, [[Exploding Enemies]], [[Glass]], [[Committed]], [[Speedy Enemies]] and [[Flying Enemies]]. These six modifiers cannot have their total reward boost exceed 50%, limiting their boosts to that. This does not prevent modifiers not part of this group from applying their boosts. For example, [[Fog]] will still apply its 20% reward boost when all six are applied, increasing the reward boost from 50% to 70%, though still lower from the expected 95%.

==Effects==
When applied, the base tower placement limit is reduced for each player by 50%. As it is the base tower placement limit that is getting reduced, Re-enforcements [[Skills|Skill]] is not affected by it.
